records.source: Buy a Joja Cola for 75g?
records.translation: Bumili ng Joja Cola sa halagang 75g?

records.source: Come back when someone's working.
records.translation: Bumalik kapag may nagtatrabaho na rito.

records.source: Closed until summer.
records.translation: Sarado hanggang tag-init.

records.source:
The Shrine Of Illusions
Make an offering of 500g to change your appearance?
records.translation:
Ang Dambana ng mga Ilusyon
Maghandog ng 500g upang baguhin ang iyong anyo?

records.source: Purchase (2,000g)
records.translation: Bilhin (2,000g)

records.source: Purchase (10,000g)
records.translation: Bilhin (10,000g)

records.source: Not now
records.translation: Huwag muna

records.source: Backpack Upgrade -- 24 slots
records.translation: Pagpapahusay ng Bag -- 24 na puwesto

records.source: Backpack Upgrade -- 36 slots
records.translation: Pagpapahusay ng Bag -- 36 na puwesto

records.source: Buy 100 Qi Coins for 1,000g?
records.translation: Bumili ng 100 Barya ni Qi sa halagang 1,000g?

records.source: Its maw gapes at the desert sun. Even in death, it yearns for a taste.
records.translation: Nakanganga ang bibig nito sa araw ng disyerto. Kahit patay na, nananabik pa rin itong makatikim.

records.source: You place the essence in the dragon's maw. Only then do you notice a note hidden in the eye socket:
records.translation: Inilagay mo ang esensiya sa bibig ng dragon. Saka mo lamang napansin ang talang nakatago sa butas ng mata:

records.source: 'You've proven yourself, kid. Check out the pile of lumber next to your house. -Mr. Qi'
records.translation: 'Napatunayan mo ang sarili mo, bata. Tingnan mo ang bunton ng kahoy sa tabi ng bahay mo. -G. Qi'

records.source: It's an empty box.
records.translation: Isa itong kahong walang laman.

records.source: You throw the shell into the box. Immediately, a note falls down from the rafters above:
records.translation: Inihagis mo ang kabibe sa kahon. Agad na nahulog mula sa biga sa itaas ang isang tala:

records.source: 'Well done. Your next task: Place 10 beets inside Mayor's fridge. -Mr. Qi'
records.translation: 'Magaling. Ang susunod mong gawain: Maglagay ng 10 beet sa pridyider ng Alkalde. -G. Qi'

records.source: Pelican Town Ledger Book... It looks like the mayor uses this to keep track of finances.
records.translation: Aklat-Talaan ng Bayan ng Pelican... Mukhang ginagamit ito ng alkalde upang subaybayan ang pananalapi.

records.source: If any farmhands join your farm, you can transfer money to each other.
records.translation: Kung may mga katuwang sa bukid na sasali sa iyong bukid, maaari kayong magpadala ng pera sa isa't isa.

records.source: Pelican Town Ledger Book... The owner of the farm can request the mayor to split the funds of the farmhands.
records.translation: Aklat-Talaan ng Bayan ng Pelican... Maaaring hilingin ng may-ari ng bukid sa alkalde na hatiin ang pondo ng mga katuwang sa bukid.

records.source: Split the funds of each farmer? Tonight, the money will be divided evenly. If you change your mind, come back here before night's end.
records.translation: Hatiin ang pondo ng bawat magsasaka? Pantay-pantay na hahatiin ang pera ngayong gabi. Kung magbago ang isip mo, bumalik dito bago matapos ang gabi.

records.source: Cancel splitting up funds?
records.translation: Kanselahin ang paghahati ng pondo?

records.source: It's the mayor's ledger book. What would you like to do?
records.translation: Ito ang aklat-talaan ng alkalde. Ano ang gusto mong gawin?

records.source: Send Money
records.translation: Magpadala ng Pera

records.source: Merge Funds
records.translation: Pagsamahin ang Pondo

records.source: Cancel Merging Funds
records.translation: Kanselahin ang Pagsasama ng Pondo

records.source: Leave
records.translation: Umalis

records.source: Cancel
records.translation: Kanselahin

records.source: Merge the funds of each farmer? Tonight, everyone's money will be combined. If you change your mind, come back here before night's end.
records.translation: Pagsamahin ang pondo ng bawat magsasaka? Pagsasamahin ang pera ng lahat ngayong gabi. Kung magbago ang isip mo, bumalik dito bago matapos ang gabi.

records.source: Cancel merging funds?
records.translation: Kanselahin ang pagsasama ng pondo?

records.source: Who would you like to send money to?
records.translation: Kanino mo gustong magpadala ng pera?

records.source: How much money would you like to send?
records.translation: Magkano ang gusto mong ipadala?

records.source: Pelican Town Marriage Log... After marriage, you may file for divorce here. Let's hope that isn't necessary!
records.translation: Talaan ng Kasal sa Bayan ng Pelican... Pagkatapos magpakasal, maaari kang maghain ng diborsiyo rito. Sana'y hindi iyon kailanganin!

records.source: File for divorce? There is a 50,000g fee.
records.translation: Maghain ng diborsiyo? May bayad itong 50,000g.

records.source: Cancel your divorce?
records.translation: Kanselahin ang iyong diborsiyo?

records.source: Your divorce request has been cancelled.
records.translation: Kinansela na ang kahilingan mo para sa diborsiyo.

records.source: Your divorce papers have been filed, but your spouse won't know until tomorrow morning. If you change your mind, come back here before night's end.
records.translation: Naihain na ang mga papeles mo sa diborsiyo, ngunit bukas ng umaga pa ito malalaman ng iyong asawa. Kung magbago ang isip mo, bumalik dito bago matapos ang gabi.

records.source: It's the mayor's fridge. It's mostly full of milk and iced tea.
records.translation: Ito ang pridyider ng alkalde. Karamihan sa laman nito ay gatas at malamig na tsaa.

records.source: You quickly place the beets in the fridge. Wait a sec... there's a note taped to the milk. It's addressed to you:
records.translation: Mabilis mong inilagay ang mga beet sa pridyider. Sandali... may talang nakadikit sa gatas. Para ito sa iyo:

records.source: 'Good job, kid. Your final task: Give the sand dragon his last meal. -Mr. Qi'
records.translation: 'Mahusay, bata. Ang huli mong gawain: Ibigay sa dragon sa disyerto ang huling pagkain nito. -G. Qi'

records.source: It's a battery powered lock-box. Unfortunately, there's no battery in it.
records.translation: Isa itong nakakandadong kahon na pinatatakbo ng baterya. Sa kasamaang-palad, wala itong baterya.

records.source: It worked! The lock-box swings open. Inside, there's a note:
records.translation: Gumana! Bumukas ang nakakandadong kahon. May tala sa loob:

records.source: 'Your first task: Bring a rainbow shell to the train platform. Leave it in the box. -Mr. Qi'
records.translation: 'Ang una mong gawain: Magdala ng Kabibing Bahaghari sa himpilan ng tren. Iwan ito sa kahon. -G. Qi'

records.source: The door is locked.
records.translation: Naka-lock ang pinto.

records.source: You insert the skull key into the keyhole. It's a perfect fit!
records.translation: Ipinasok mo ang Susi ng Bungo sa butas ng susi. Eksaktong-eksakto ang sukat!

records.source: {0} is sleeping.
records.translation: Natutulog si {0}.

records.source: Whatever this once was, it's now in ruins.
records.translation: Anuman ito noon, guho na ito ngayon.

records.translation: = Kariton ng Junimo =

records.translation: Mode ng Pagsulong

records.translation: Mode na Walang Hanggan

records.translation: Lumabas
